title: Explicit uncurrying calculation for ordinary scheme evaluation
statement: For arbitrary scheme complexes P,F, put O equal to the single tensor unit and V=Hom(P,O). Let f:Tot(F tensor V) to Hom(P,F) satisfy the ordinary component equation. Let phiF be f followed by Hom(P,eta_F), and phiO=Hom(P,eta_O), where eta is the fixed K-injective augmentation. The composite (mu(F,V) tensor identity_QP);mu(Tot(F,V),P);Q Uncurry(phiF);(Q eta_F)^-1 equals associator;QF tensor (mu(V,P);Q Uncurry(phiO);(Q eta_O)^-1;the inverse quotient comparison at O);right unitor. Uncurry is the explicit coproduct extension of sheaf evaluation. This is an equation of constructed morphisms and involves no canonical derived tensor-Hom family, derived Hom comparison, representative isomorphisms, flatness or invertibility of mu.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary chain calculation to obtain an evaluation e into the single unit and the two chain equalities factoring the explicit uncurrying maps through the fixed augmentations.

Apply the proved localization coherence to e. Rewrite the two chain factorizations under Q and cancel Q(eta_F) and Q(eta_O) against schemeHomResolutionInverse using their defining inverse laws. Reassociation gives the stated equality.

theorem schemeOrdinaryEvaluation_uncurry_calculation (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (P F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : pullbackTensorTotal Y F
        (homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
            (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))) ⟶
      homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P F)
    (hf : IsSchemeOrdinaryEvaluation Y P F f) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let O := (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))
    let V := homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P O
    let eta := CochainComplex.toKInjectiveResolution.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    let phiF := f ≫ ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app F)
    let phiO := ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app O)
    (pullbackTensorModelMap Y F V ▷ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        pullbackTensorModelMap Y (pullbackTensorTotal Y F V) P ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (schemeTensorHomUncurry Y (pullbackTensorTotal Y F V) P F phiF) ≫
        schemeHomResolutionInverse Y F =
      (α_ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj V)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).hom ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj F ◁
        (pullbackTensorModelMap Y V P ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry Y V P O phiO) ≫
          schemeHomResolutionInverse Y O ≫
          ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).app O).inv) ≫
      (ρ_ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F)).hom
